notes.title: New Gameplay Mode Released - SCORE ATTACK!
notes.notes:
NEW! SCORE ATTACK MODE

Chaos Moon gets it’s first update and it’s a cracking Score Attack mode for all you high-score jockeys out there.
Chain together successive 'Enemy' kills without missing one to increase your score Chain/Multiplier and light up those Leaderboards.

Score Attack is a fun challenge and encourages you to play strategically and make sure you pick out the enemies to kill before they go offscreen (resetting the multiplier).
This is harder than it sounds. Can you get to the end of the level without missing a single enemy and maximize the multiplier and your score?

HINT:
When we say enemies, we mean intelligent alien occupied craft and gun emplacements, not inanimate objects like asteroids, debris or mines.

The challenge is laid down...
Get your shmup pants on and see if you can get to the top of the leaderboard and occupy the coveted NUMBER 1 Spot.
